2016 HYUNDAI VELOSTER
SAMENESS HAS AN ENEMY.
IT’S CALLED VELOSTER.
W ith Hyundai Veloster, we created something different from all other compact sport
coupes. It’s inspired not by other cars, but by high-performance street bikes. You
can see it in the shapes that surround you, inside and out. And feel it in the way
Veloster uses its outstanding power-to-weight ratio and exclusive Dual Clutch
Transmission to accelerate, shift and handle with breathtaking quickness.
But let’s slow down for a moment. We’re not just talking about a singular Veloster model. Four
distinct 2016 models – Veloster, Veloster Turbo, Turbo R-Spec and the new Rally Edition1 – let
you choose precisely how you roll.
Whichever one you call yours, expect two things you won’t find on any other compact sport
coupe. First, there’s an exclusive three-door design that makes it easy for rear passengers
to join the fun. Second, Veloster has the most interior volume of any car in its class.2 The
functionality beneath Veloster’s form will astonish you: Leave the rear seats up, and you’ve got
15.5 cubic feet – more than some leading compact sedans. Fold the rear seats flat, and 34.7
cubic feet of space becomes readily accessible via the wide (and low) rear hatch opening.
And that’s good, since Veloster has once again hauled off with more coveted hardware – from
multiple first-place trophies on the Global Rallycross Championship circuit in 2014 to a 5-Star
Overall Safety Rating in 2015.3
1 Limited production model. 2 Claim based on comparison of specifications on manufacturer websites. 3 Government star ratings are part of the
National Highway Traffic Safety Administration’s (NHTSA's) New Car Assessment Program (safercar.gov).
